as_told.title: Chase Brandon's 2012 book about a secret NHI committee and timelines

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, points to a book called The Cryptos Conundrum by Chase Brandon, a former CIA officer who worked as the agency's liaison to Hollywood. Michels says the book discusses Roscoe Hillenkoetter, one of the first CIA directors, who he says dealt with Roswell, the 1947 event in New Mexico where some say a craft came down. He presents the book as an insider's hint about what the CIA knew of that event.
